exposure: Counseling about trial of labor after cesarean during antenatal follow-up
cohort: 115 women who successfully delivered vaginally after previous cesarean delivery (cases) and 115 women who had a cesarean section after trial of labor (controls) in public hospitals in East Wollega, Western Ethiopia in 2020.
finding: Rural residence, no history of stillbirth, prior vaginal birth after cesarean, counseling about trial of labor during antenatal care, and birth interval >2 years were associated with successful vaginal birth after cesarean.
mod_finding: Counseling about mode of delivery during antenatal care was found to be a determinant of successful trial of labor after cesarean.
